request.decision_question: Should Elgon Water Kiosks open paid water points in Mbale, which needs the water authority's operating permit?

claims.claim: Mbale ward leaders support paid water kiosks.
Households in Mbale want kiosk water.
Elgon Water Kiosks holds the water authority's operating permit for Mbale.

evidence_pack.claim: Eleven of the 14 ward leaders interviewed said they support paid kiosks in their wards.
72% of the 400 households surveyed said they would buy kiosk water at the proposed price.
The Directorate of Water Resources issued operating permit DWR/OP/2026/118 to Elgon Water Kiosks Ltd on 18 October 2026 for Mbale.

request.decision_question: Should Rift Seed Co start selling certified maize seed in Nakuru?

claims.claim: Nakuru farmer groups back the new seed variety.
Agrovets in Nakuru want to stock the variety.
KEPHIS certified the seed variety for sale.

evidence_pack.claim: Farmer group chairs in Nakuru told the field team they back the new seed variety.
At least 60 of the 85 agrovets surveyed in Nakuru want to stock the variety next season.
KEPHIS issued seed certificate KE-SC-44120 for the variety on 11 October 2026.

request.decision_question: Should Northern Care open a private clinic in Tamale, given it needs facility licensing?

claims.claim: Tamale health workers support the new clinic.
Tamale residents would use the clinic.
The Health Facilities Regulatory Agency licensed the Tamale clinic.

evidence_pack.claim: Most of the 30 health workers consulted support a private clinic in Tamale.
More than 500 of the 800 residents surveyed said they would use the clinic within a year.
The Health Facilities Regulatory Agency issued licence HeFRA-2026-7781 for the Tamale clinic on 15 October 2026.

requested_effects.description: Recommend the clinic to the investment committee
